must_catch.item: ACV is $210,000 per year, and the close does not list deal size as a gap
The outcome carries the online-only scope note
The decision-maker contradiction is surfaced (Maya chose, Greg decided)

data.notes: The report gets the core right: the scoped 'Won' (memberships only, front desk still on Global, phase two undated), the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction, and value proof on the customer's own file as the deciding factor. It misses that the front desk is still a live competitive deal. Neither the 'decided' insight nor the rep takeaway says the win covers online billing only or that phase two must be worked as an open deal. The close also wrongly lists the decider question as 'dodged' when the transcript answered it, and the competitor excerpt is attributed to Maya although the rep said it.
